semanticHashPolicy.importContractProjection: all top-level import behavior fields except semanticHashPolicy

componentProjection.identityBindings: v1 bindings plus the two v2 generated import bindings
componentProjection.objectModel: the 47 v2 direct target table declarations selected from the canonical object model
componentProjection.disposition: v1 disposition with both definition import tables moved from derived to definitionSeed
componentProjection.fieldMap: v1 field map with exact definition import targets added to item and currency

semanticHashPolicy.compatibilityBoundary: V2 accepts only its current semantic contract. Existing V1 COMPLETE runs must replay or roll back through V1.

transactionBoundary: one COMPLETE V2 catalog projection includes definition provenance imports, preflights all rows, inserts definitions before their import bindings and commits all targets plus receipts in one outer transaction
replay: same V2 profile and semantic contract is zero-write replay; V1 and V2 identities are not interchangeable
rollback: use the profile that created the run and delete imported target rows in reverse import order
